subject: [PATCH] mm/swap: submit the last readahead batch before unplugging

reviews.author: Christoph Hellwig
reviews.summary: Christoph found the patch good and provided a Reviewed-by tag.

2026-10-05.patch_summary: This patch modifies the swap readahead logic to submit the final batch before finishing the plug, ensuring that all I/O operations are properly batched and merged by the block layer.
